description: R08 Host ApiRoutines input-mode checkpoint: safe Rust owns Microsoft's SetConsoleInputModeImpl state machine across ordinary flags, extended flag preservation/clearing, invalid-mode reporting, insert/cursor transitions, cooked-read propagation and the PSReadLine compatibility scenario.

entries.notes: Ordinary processed/line/echo bits are stored exactly and succeed without changing console-global extended state.
ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS applies quick-edit and auto-position outside the InputBuffer mode field.
With ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS present, omitted quick-edit/auto-position bits clear their prior console-global state.
Unknown bits are still stored while the API reports InvalidArgument.
Insert-mode transitions update console state and disable cursor double mode when the insert value changes without an active cooked read.
The same insert transition is propagated into active cooked-read state while preserving the cursor transition contract.
Echo without line input is applied to InputBuffer mode but returns InvalidArgument.
Extended bits may be enabled without ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS; absent extended bits are preserved unless ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS authorizes clearing them.
The 0x1F7 to 0x1E4 PSReadLine transition preserves insert/quick-edit/auto-position, stores echo-only ordinary mode and reports InvalidArgument because line input is absent.
